battle.name: 北齊攻梁之戰
battle.brief: 承光二年（556），北齊趁西魏陷江陵、梁朝崩解，自河南渡淮南下，企圖扶梁敬帝蕭方智與湘州王琳，控制江淮水道；陳霸先倚建康城與玄武湖水軍抵禦，齊軍終未入建康。卡面月牙劍是單刃彎身、砍入不拔的近身冷兵器，在本役的對照是中原直刃環首刀與馬槊所在的近戰序列。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 北齊天保年間以後，高氏定都鄴城，與關中的西魏（後改北周）南北對峙；梁則只剩建康一座孤城，名義上的君主是十餘歲的蕭方智，實權在荊州、湘州出身的陳霸先手上。554 年冬，西魏大軍順漢水、荊水南下，攻陷江陵，梁元帝蕭繢被俘，次年遇害，宗室與將士多被押往關中，江南只剩建康與湘、鄂一帶的水軍殘部。北齊不甘坐看西魏獨吞江淮，於承光元年、二年（555、556）先後遣兵南向：兵鋒沿河南、淮北而下，一面以舟師循水路直趨建康，一面冊封梁敬帝、輸送衣械，企圖在江南扶植一個受北齊節制名義政權，把江淮與荊湘的水道網連成一體，在與西魏的邊界上換取縱深。梁方以陳霸先所領的荊湘兵為骨幹，倚建康城池與長江水障，攔住北齊的陸路前鋒；北齊支持的另一支梁系武裝首領王琳則據湘州水軍，在洞庭、湘江一線與陳霸先相持。三方在同一條江淮水道上角力：北齊想由北向南接管，陳霸先要逐個擊破，王琳則想借外兵奪回建康。
countriesEn: The campaign of 556 unfolded over the ruins of the Liang dynasty. Northern Qi, founded by the Gao clan and seated at Ye on the Hebei plain, had spent years facing the Western Wei regime in Guanzhong across the Yellow River; Liang, by contrast, had been reduced to the single city of Jiankang, its nominal sovereign the child-prince Xiao Fangzhi, while real power sat with Chen Baxian, the commander who came up from Jing and Xiang. In the winter of 554 the Western Wei host moved down the Han and Jing rivers, took Jiangling, and carried off Emperor Yuan Xiao Yi, who was killed the following year; the imperial clan and the officers of the old court were taken north in captivity, and what remained of Liang was the Jiankang garrison together with the river fleets of the Jing and Xiang regions. Qi would not sit still while Western Wei swallowed the Jiang-Huai. In the first and second years of the Chengguang era (555 and 556) it sent columns south in succession: the line of advance running down from Henan and north of the Huai, a fleet moving by water toward Jiankang, and at the same time the recognition of the Liang pretender together with arms and cloth, so as to install in the south a regime answerable to the northern court and to stitch the waterways of the Jiang-Huai and the Jing-Xiang into one block, gaining depth on a frontier shared with Western Wei. Liang's side rested on the troops of Jing and Xiang led by Chen Baxian, screened by the walls of Jiankang and by the Yangtze itself, and it was they who checked the northern advance by land. The other Liang-aligned host, under Wang Lin and given the title Prince of Southern Chu, held the river forces of Xiang and the waters of Dongting, and contended with Chen Baxian there. Three sides therefore fought for the same corridor: Qi wished to take the south from the north, Chen Baxian meant to break them one at a time, and Wang Lin wanted the foreign troops to carry him back into Jiankang.
people: 留下姓名的多在梁這一邊。梁武帝蕭衍已於侯景之亂中崩於建康；侯景自 548 年渡江，到 552 年敗亡，梁的宗室與將領在數年間死傷散盡，蕭衍的兒子蕭綱早卒，蕭棟被侯景所殺，蕭繢以江陵為根據地稱帝，一年後被西魏俘囚而死，能撐到最後的蕭方智只有十餘歲，軍國大事全由尚書令陳霸先裁決。陳霸先出身寒微，早年在嶺南起兵，平定侯景餘部，再以荊州、湘州的降兵為主力東下，是這場戰爭裡梁方真正的主帥與決策者；他將水軍集結在建康城外的玄武湖一帶操練，遣侯安都、侯瑱、周文育、杜僧明、徐度等分領舟師與步騎，選將、定策、調糧都由他一人決定。王僧辯是梁的老將，名位在陳霸先之上，握著建康的宿衛與部分軍權，兩人互相猜忌，最終在建康的權力交接中被陳霸先除掉。王琳是齊方倚重的南楚王，靠湘、鄂一帶的舊部與北齊的資助另立旗號。北齊與西魏一方的核心，則是北齊朝廷在高洋、高湛手中的樞紐，以及西魏宇文泰、宇文護的幕府；統軍大將的姓名在《北齊書》中多以官職與表字殘缺的方式留下，較完整者可數者有限。
peopleEn: Most of the names that survive belong to the Liang side. Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, had already died in the siege of Jiankang during the Hou Jing rebellion; Hou Jing had crossed the river in 548 with a few thousand men and his host had collapsed in defeat by 552, and the deaths and dispersal of the Liang clan and its commanders in those years left the dynasty hollow. Xiao Gang, Xiao Yan's heir, died early; Xiao Dong was killed by Hou Jing himself; Xiao Yi proclaimed himself emperor at Jiangling and was taken by Western Wei within a year, dying in captivity soon after. The only Liang ruler to hold out was Xiao Fangzhi, still a child, and every decision of state was made by the chancellor Chen Baxian. Chen came from a poor family, rose in the revolt in the far south, put down the surviving forces of Hou Jing, and then marched east with the surrendered troops of Jing and Xiang; in this campaign he was the real commander and decision-maker on the Liang side. He mustered the fleet on the Xuanwu Lake outside Jiankang, and dispatched Hou Andu, Hou Zhen, Zhou Wenyu, Du Sengming and Xu Du to lead the river squadrons and the foot and horse, choosing commanders, settling policy and moving grain himself. Wang Sengbian, the old general of Liang, outranked Chen and held part of the imperial guard and the command in Jiankang; the two distrusted each other, and Chen finally removed him in the transfer of power in the capital. Wang Lin was the Prince of Southern Chu on whom Qi relied, maintaining a separate authority with the old troops of Xiang and E and the resources sent from the north. On the northern side the effective figures were the Qi court under Gao Yang and Gao Zhan and the Western Wei camp of Yuwen Tai and Yuwen Hu; the names of the commanders who led the columns survive in the History of Northern Qi mostly as offices and courtesy names, and few are given in full.
kits: 卡面這件埃及月牙劍屬於前鐵器時代的冷兵器：單刃，刃身向外彎成新月形，砍進去不必把刀拔出來，適合貼身格鬥時一擊即脫手。它在本場戰爭裡的位置，是單刃劈砍型近身冷兵器這一類的原型。而北齊與梁在戰場上真正上手的，仍是中原的直刃環首刀、儀刀與槊，騎兵用馬槊，步兵用長矛與方天畫戟，弓弩分列前後，披札甲、鐵鎧與漆盾；攻城一方備雲梯、撞車與擲石用的砲，水軍則靠樓船、走舸與蒙衝在江面上爭水道。馬匹是這場戰役的另一件關鍵裝備：北齊的騎兵靠並州、幽州與河南的馬群維持機動，梁方軍馬不足，多用荊湘與淮南所產的馬，舟車轉運的極限反而落在水軍一側。月牙劍本身不會出現在鄴城或建康的陣前，它代表的是另一條技術路徑——把刃口做彎、以切割代替穿刺，用更少的力氣取得傷害。從這個角度看，這場戰爭裡真正的近戰裝備，正是被它對照出來的那一端：北齊騎兵的環首刀與馬槊、陳霸先軍中的長矛與大盾，雙方的冷兵器都走直刃長兵器的路子，靠刺與揮砍的力道取勝，與月牙劍那條弧刃的路子正好相反。
kitsEn: The khopesh on the card belongs to the early-metal age of cold weapons, before iron: a single edge whose blade curves outward into the shape of a new moon, made so that the sword does not have to be pulled back out of a wound, which suits a close-quarters exchange of cuts that ends in one stroke. Its place in this campaign is as the archetype of the single-edged cutting blade used at arm's length. What the Qi and Liang troops actually carried into the field were the straight-edged ring-pommel swords and ceremonial blades of the Central Plains, the long spear and the mace-spear of the horsemen, the long spear and the halberd of the foot, bows and crossbows deployed in depth, and lamellar and iron armour with lacquered shields; the besiegers brought scaling ladders, battering rams and stone-throwing engines, while the fleets fought for the waterways with tower ships, light racing boats and covered ram-ships. Horses were the second critical piece of equipment in this war: the Qi cavalry drew its mounts from the herds of Bingzhou, Youzhou and Henan, while Liang had too few and used horses from Jing, Xiang and Huainan, so that the limit of wheeled transport fell on the river fleet instead. The khopesh itself would never have appeared before Ye or Jiankang; it stands for a different line of technical development, in which the edge is curved and cutting rather than piercing, trading force for effect. Read that way, the real close-combat equipment of this war is the opposite pole the card sets against it: the ring-pommel sword and mace-spear of the Qi cavalry, the long spear and large shield of Chen Baxian's men, all straight-edged weapons that win by thrusting and by the weight of the swing, exactly the opposite of the khopesh's arc.
tactics: 北齊的戰法以騎兵為先鋒、以舟車與糧道為骨：步兵護著攻城器械沿河緩行，騎兵尋隙越淮、趨江北，企圖迅速插入建康城北的空隙，逼陳霸先分兵應戰；一旦受阻，便退往淮北與豫州一帶的營壘整頓，再尋別路。梁方倚城而守：陳霸先把水軍集於玄武湖，以舟師封住城北水道，弩手列於城頭，步兵據城郊塹壘，弓弩與砲交錯射擊，遏住敵軍的攻城序列；侯安都率舟師夜襲敵營，焚其舟糧，反過來斷齊軍的糧道，迫使北齊前鋒退兵。湘州方面，王琳依水造舟，以連船塞住湘江支流，游擊陳霸先的糧船，陳霸先另遣杜僧明、侯瑱率兵水陸夾攻，奪取江陵外圍的據點。整體而言，這場戰爭是騎兵速決與水軍控制的對撞：北齊想用速度換取決勝，梁方用水障與城防換取時間，最後由糧草與士氣決定局面。
tacticsEn: Qi led with cavalry and built the campaign on horsemen, wagons and supply: the infantry escorted the siege train and advanced slowly along the water, while the cavalry looked for a gap, crossed the Huai and pressed toward the north bank of the Yangtze, hoping to slip into the open ground north of Jiankang and force Chen Baxian to divide his army; checked, they withdrew to the camps in northern Huai and in Yuzhou to reform and look for another road. Liang fought from its walls. Chen Baxian concentrated his fleet on Xuanwu Lake and sealed the waterways north of the city with his own boats, posted crossbowmen along the ramparts and troops in the ditches and works outside the walls, and crossed bows with stones thrown by engines to check the enemy's siege sequence. Hou Andu took the river fleet out at night to fall on the northern camp, burning their boats and grain, and so reversed the situation by cutting the supply road Qi depended on and forcing the forward columns back. In the Xiang region, Wang Lin built his position on the water, chaining boats to choke the tributaries of the Xiang river and raiding Chen's grain convoys, while Chen sent Du Sengming and Hou Zhen by land and sea together to seize the outposts beyond the river. Taken as a whole, the campaign was a collision between cavalry decision and river control: Qi wanted to win on speed, Liang bought time with the water barrier and the city walls, and in the end supply and morale settled it.
data: 能夠確認的數字有限。江陵陷落時，西魏出兵數萬至十餘萬，戰船數千艘，順漢水一路直下，十一月城破；侯景之亂前後，其眾由數千膨脹至數萬以上，佔據建康逾年，防守序列折損極重，這是梁元氣大傷的源頭。北齊在承光二年（556）南下的部隊，各史只概稱步騎數萬，沒有留下完整名冊，也沒有精確的損耗數字；梁方水軍在玄武湖一役擊潰敵舟，史書僅記斬獲甚眾一類的概說，受降與被俘部隊以千計。距離方面，鄴城至建康陸路約一千二百里，沿運河與淮水順流而下約千里；江陵至建康水路亦約千里，北方援軍循漢水而下與順長江東下，恰好夾住建康西面的荊州通道。時間上，自 554 年江陵陷落到 557 年十月陳霸先受禪建陳，整場戰爭歷時不足四年，中間還夾著侯景餘部與王琳勢力兩條支線。各史留下的確切人數與兵器數目，多已散佚，僅能就上列概數為據。
dataEn: The figures that can be confirmed are few. When Jiangling fell, Western Wei had committed some tens of thousands of men, in places reported as over a hundred thousand, with several thousand boats coming down the Han river; the city was taken in the eleventh month. During the Hou Jing rebellion his host grew from a few thousand men to well over ten thousand, and possibly several tens of thousands, and it held Jiankang for more than a year, leaving the defending garrison and the city's armaments badly worn; that is the source of Liang's ruined strength. The Qi's southern columns of 556 are described only in general terms as several tens of thousands of foot and horse, with no complete roster and no exact casualty figures. The Liang fleet broke the enemy boats in the action on Xuanwu Lake, but the histories record only a general formula of great slaughter and captures, with surrenders and prisoners numbering in the thousands. As for distances: Ye to Jiankang is roughly 1,200 li by road and about a thousand li downstream along the canals and the Huai, while Jiangling to Jiankang by water is also about a thousand li, so that the relief columns coming down the Han and the ones coming east along the Yangtze both closed around the Jingzhou corridor west of Jiankang. In time, the campaign ran from the fall of Jiangling in 554 to Chen Baxian's acceptance of the abdication and the founding of Chen in the tenth month of 557, less than four years in all, with two other threads running through it, the surviving forces of Hou Jing and the armed following of Wang Lin. The exact numbers of men and of weapons have largely been lost, and only the rough counts above can be relied on.
cause: 打起來的緣由有三層。第一層是侯景之亂留下的破局：548 年侯景以數千兵渡江，兩年之間攻陷建康，燒毀宮室，殺盡宗室，梁的軍隊與政權元氣盡失，中原南北兩朝都趁勢用兵。第二層是西魏的兼併：554 年宇文泰遣兵沿漢水東下，一舉佔據江陵與三楚之地，企圖順勢掃平建康，把南朝最後一線血脈消滅乾淨。第三層是北齊的算盤：西魏與北齊隔河相望，若讓西魏獨得江南，雙方在河南與淮上的拉鋸就會失去意義，北齊遂藉扶植蕭方智與王琳，把勢力伸入江南，既換取邊界上的縱深，也順勢削弱西魏的西南翼。梁方內部同樣不穩：王琳與陳霸先爭奪建康的帝位，陳霸先不願讓王琳借外兵坐大，也不願讓北齊兵馬長驅直入建康，兩邊便先在湘、鄂水道上開戰，北齊的兵馬才有可乘之機，這是整場戰爭最複雜的一層因果。
causeEn: There are three layers to the reason the fighting began. The first is the collapse left behind by the Hou Jing rebellion: in 548 Hou Jing crossed the Yangtze with a few thousand men, took Jiankang within two years, burned the palaces and killed the imperial clan, the dynasty's armed force and government were gutted, and both northern states moved in to take advantage. The second is the annexation by Western Wei: in 554 Yuwen Tai sent an army down the Han river, seized Jiangling and the lands of the three Chu regions in a single stroke, and prepared to sweep away Jiankang and extinguish the last line of the southern house. The third is Qi's calculation: Western Wei and Qi faced each other across the river, and if Western Wei were left to take the south alone the seesaw they had fought over Henan and the Huai would lose all meaning, so Qi pushed in to support Xiao Fangzhi and Wang Lin, extending its own reach into the south, gaining depth on the frontier and weakening Western Wei's southwestern flank at the same time. Liang was no more stable within itself: Wang Lin and Chen Baxian were fighting over who would sit on the Jiankang throne, and Chen would not let Wang Lin grow strong on foreign troops, nor let Qi's soldiers ride unopposed into the capital. The two therefore collided first along the waterways of the Jing and E regions, and only then did the Qi troops find the opening they had hoped for. That is the most tangled layer of cause and effect in the whole war.
impact: 影響分遠近兩端。近端是南北形勢的重新排位：梁朝在 557 年十月覆亡，陳霸先受梁敬帝禪讓建立陳朝，定都仍在建康，這個政權靠荊湘軍人集團撐起來，卻無力收復江陵，荊州一帶仍握在西魏（後改稱北周）手中，南北從此在長江中下游長期對峙。遠端是北方王朝干預江南的先例：北齊這次沒有得手，但齊與後來的北周仍沿同一條路線南下，589 年隋軍渡江，陳朝覆滅；從侯景之亂到隋滅陳，江南政權數次在軍事崩潰之後重建，每次都靠荊州方面的軍隊與水軍支撐，經濟重心也因此遲遲沒有完全回到建康一帶的舊日水平。另一面，這場戰爭把北齊的西線兵力拖向南方，南北邊境在淮上拉鋸加劇，直到 578 年北周滅北齊，格局才有根本改變。
impactEn: The effects work on two scales. In the near term the balance between north and south was rearranged: the Liang was extinguished in the tenth month of 557, Chen Baxian took the abdication from Emperor Jing of Liang and founded the Chen, keeping the capital at Jiankang, but this new state, resting on the military group from Jing and Xiang, was never able to recover Jiangling, which remained in the hands of Western Wei, later renamed Northern Zhou, and north and south now faced one another along the middle and lower Yangtze. In the longer run the campaign set the precedent for northern intervention in the south: Qi's attempt failed, but Qi and then Northern Zhou continued along the same road until the Sui armies crossed the river in 589 and the Chen fell. From Hou Jing's rebellion to the Sui conquest, southern regimes were rebuilt several times after military collapse, each time on the strength of the troops and fleets of the Jingzhou region, so the economic centre of the south never fully recovered its former level around Jiankang. On the other side, the war dragged Qi's western forces southward and intensified the contest along the Huai, and that frontier was not fundamentally altered until Northern Zhou destroyed Northern Qi in 578.
result: 結果分三層可講。第一層：江陵失守，梁元帝被俘，江陵與荊州數十年累積的典章文物與兵械被帶走，這是侯景之亂後南朝的第二次崩潰，也是隋統一前江南最後一次大損失。第二層：北齊的南下部隊始終沒有拿下建康，也沒有把王琳扶上帝位，騎兵與舟師在江淮水道上屢遭夜襲與封鎖，糧道拉得太長，前出的部隊遂陸續退回淮北；北齊在這場戰爭中沒有得到江南，只換回一個名義上的蕭方智與一支不聽節制的南楚王勢力，得失遠不相稱。第三層：557 年十月陳霸先廢梁敬帝，自立為陳武帝，建康從此換了國號；王琳敗走楚州一帶，其部眾後來多為陳所收，一部分歸於北周，南楚王的旗號就此收束。這場戰爭的淨結果，是北齊與西魏都沒有得到完整的江南，而江南最終由陳霸先這個出身寒微的武將收束成陳，南北對峙的格局延續了三十二年，到 589 年才由隋軍渡江終結。
resultEn: The outcome can be read on three levels. First, Jiangling was lost: Emperor Yuan was taken captive, and the accumulated statutes, books and weapons of Jiangling and the Jing region were carried away, the second collapse of the southern house after the rebellion of Hou Jing and the last great loss the south would suffer before Sui unification. Second, Qi's southern columns never took Jiankang and never seated Wang Lin on the throne; its cavalry and fleets were harried and sealed off along the Jiang-Huai waterways, the supply line was stretched too far, and the forward columns withdrew one after another to the north of the Huai. Qi gained no real foothold in the south, trading only a nominal Xiao Fangzhi and an unruly Prince of Southern Chu for the effort, a poor bargain. Third, in the tenth month of 557 Chen Baxien deposed Emperor Jing of Liang and took the title Emperor Wu of Chen, and Jiankang changed its state name; Wang Lin's forces were broken in the Chu region, his adherents were later taken by Chen, some of them ending up in Northern Zhou, and the banner of the Prince of Southern Chu was folded away for good. The net result of the campaign was that neither Qi nor Western Wei obtained a complete south, while the south was finally gathered by Chen Baxian, a general of humble origin, into the state of Chen; the north-south standoff lasted another thirty-two years, until the Sui armies crossed the river in 589.
